TestCase.name: testDifferentUdfInConditionAndProjection
TestCase.Resource: SELECT pyFunc1(a, b) FROM MyTable WHERE pyFunc2(a, c) > 0
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[pyFunc1($0, $1)]) +- LogicalFilter(condition=[>(pyFunc2($0, $2), 0)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])

PythonCalc(select=[pyFunc1(a, b) AS EXPR$0]) +- Calc(select=[a, b], where=[(f0 > 0)]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, b, pyFunc2(a, c) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testDistinctCallsAreNotDeduplicated
TestCase.Resource: SELECT pyFunc1(a, b), pyFunc1(b, a), pyFunc2(a, b) FROM MyTable
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[pyFunc1($0, $1)], EXPR$1=[pyFunc1($1, $0)], EXPR$2=[pyFunc2($0, $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])
PythonCalc(select=[pyFunc1(a, b) AS EXPR$0, pyFunc1(b, a) AS EXPR$1, pyFunc2(a, b) AS EXPR$2]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testDuplicatedCallsInProjection
TestCase.Resource: SELECT pyFunc1(a, b), pyFunc1(a, b), pyFunc1(a, b) FROM MyTable
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[pyFunc1($0, $1)], EXPR$1=[pyFunc1($0, $1)], EXPR$2=[pyFunc1($0, $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])
Calc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, f0 AS EXPR$1, f0 AS EXPR$2]) +- PythonCalc(select=[pyFunc1(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testDuplicatedCallsInProjectionWithCondition
TestCase.Resource: SELECT pyFunc1(a, b), pyFunc1(a, b) FROM MyTable WHERE pyFunc1(a, b) > 0
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[pyFunc1($0, $1)], EXPR$1=[pyFunc1($0, $1)]) +- LogicalFilter(condition=[>(pyFunc1($0, $1), 0)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])
Calc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, f0 AS EXPR$1], where=[(f0 > 0)]) +- PythonCalc(select=[pyFunc1(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testDuplicatedCallsWithForwardedField
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, pyFunc1(a, b), pyFunc1(a, b) FROM MyTable
LogicalProject(a=[$0], EXPR$1=[pyFunc1($0, $1)], EXPR$2=[pyFunc1($0, $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])
Calc(select=[f0 AS a, f1 AS EXPR$1, f1 AS EXPR$2]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a AS f0, pyFunc1(a, b) AS f1]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testNestedUdfInProjectionWithSameInCondition
TestCase.Resource: SELECT pyFunc2(pyFunc1(a, b), c), pyFunc1(a, b) FROM MyTable WHERE pyFunc1(a, b) > 0

LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[pyFunc2(pyFunc1($0, $1), $2)], EXPR$1=[pyFunc1($0, $1)]) +- LogicalFilter(condition=[>(pyFunc1($0, $1), 0)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])

Calc(select=[f00 AS EXPR$0, f0 AS EXPR$1]) +- PythonCalc(select=[f0, pyFunc2(f0, c) AS f00]) +- Calc(select=[f0, c], where=[(f0 > 0)]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, b, c, pyFunc1(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testNonDeterministicCallsAreNotDeduplicated
TestCase.Resource: SELECT pyFuncNonDet(a, b), pyFuncNonDet(a, b) FROM MyTable
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[pyFuncNonDet($0, $1)], EXPR$1=[pyFuncNonDet($0, $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])
PythonCalc(select=[pyFuncNonDet(a, b) AS EXPR$0, pyFuncNonDet(a, b) AS EXPR$1]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testSameUdfInConditionAndProjection
TestCase.Resource: SELECT pyFunc1(a, b) + 1, pyFunc1(a, b) + 2 FROM MyTable WHERE pyFunc1(a, b) > 0

LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[+(pyFunc1($0, $1), 1)], EXPR$1=[+(pyFunc1($0, $1), 2)]) +- LogicalFilter(condition=[>(pyFunc1($0, $1), 0)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])

Calc(select=[(f0 + 1) AS EXPR$0, (f0 + 2) AS EXPR$1], where=[(f0 > 0)]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, b, pyFunc1(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])
